ld9.rule: In acceptance.*Health.outbound_allowlist: (a) entries ending in .sim.test in acceptance.ltiHealth.outbound_allowlist equal, as a set (no duplicates), the union of the allowlist hosts of tests/sim/hosts.json at the compared SHA; (b) every other (non-.sim.test) entry equals G-BASE (1b17261be97c4701b928fa9dc2fa74c6d23028f6) in exact order and value; (c) default.ltiHealth.outbound_allowlist, default.appHealth.outbound_allowlist, and acceptance.appHealth.outbound_allowlist stay strictly equal to G-BASE.
